title: Settings
description: All settings are optional and can be set globally or per project.

customerField.title: Customer field
customerField.description: Name of a YouTrack field that contains the customer name, e.g. "Customer". The matching customer is preselected in the entry form.

projectField.title: Project field
projectField.description: Name of a YouTrack field that contains the project name of the time tracking system. The matching project is preselected in the entry form.

serviceField.title: Service field
serviceField.description: Name of a YouTrack field that contains the service name, e.g. "Service". The matching service is preselected in the entry form.

estimationField.title: Estimation field
estimationField.description: Leave empty. The app detects the estimation field automatically. Only enter the name of a period field if the estimation is not found, for example if the project has several period fields and none is named "Estimation".

clockRounding.title: Clock rounding
clockRounding.description: Rounds the time of stopped clock entries to blocks of the selected length. Manually entered durations are never rounded.

clockRoundingMode.title: Rounding mode
clockRoundingMode.description: "Round up" counts every started block, "Round to nearest" rounds to the closest block. At least one block is always logged.

clockReminder.title: Clock reminder
clockReminder.description: Sends a YouTrack notification to the user when a clock started in an issue has been running for the selected time.
